scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Zoya sits with her ankle on pillows directing Gleb's bread kneading and Kira's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Roman chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Gleb and Zoya tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Kira, Larisa, and Matvey lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Yaroslav nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Kira and Matvey convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Larisa to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Larisa's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Zoya, Roman, and Gleb clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Yaroslav, Kira, and Larisa learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Yaroslav's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
